Sofia Patel: Quick QBR ask — aligning agenda across cloud marketplace, HW partners, and SI integrations. Need (1) a compact scorecard template we can use for partner tiers (ops + revenue + enablement), (2) a credit/allocation schedule for co-funded HW credits & marketplace promos, and (3) a one-slide runbook for joint announcement cadence. Can folks own drafts by EOD Wed? I can take the runbook.
Anya Gomez: I can draft the scorecard. Prefer a single CSV we can ingest into tableau. Will include metrics: ARR-influenced deals, joint wins, technical enablement hours, co-marketing reach. Any additions?
Matt S: Add "time-to-first-deploy" for SI partners — measuring post-sale integration velocity.
Ben Liu: Also need to bake in "quality/regression alerts" for joint models if we co-fund compute? Maybe as an ops metric.
Chris Park: For the credits schedule: we have QBR cap of $200k for APAC HW credits this FY. Suggest tier buckets: Pilot ($10k), Scale ($25k), Strategic ($75k). Can we standardize approvals?
Sofia Patel: @Chris Park good start. For approvals — propose 2-step: BD owner sign-off + Finance threshold (> $50k) exec sponsor.
Anya Gomez: CSV header proposal:
```
partner,tier,metric,period,target,owner,approval_required
```
I'll push a template to drive.
Matt S: Can you include a "marketplace listing readiness" boolean? helps timing.
Ben Liu: quick ask — does "marketing development funds" require co-marketing assets checklist? We should require an editorial calendar entry.
Sofia Patel: Yes — add "assets_ready" and "launch_window".
Partnerships Bot: Meeting created: QBR alignment workshop — Wed 10:00 PT. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.co/qbr-align :calendar_add: 
Anya Gomez: I'll upload the CSV template here once done. Planning to include an example row for AcmeCloud (SI) + DeltaGPU (HW partner).
Chris Park: Note: hardware partner needs 8-week lead time for credit fulfillment. Flagging as constraint.
Sofia Patel: Action items: Anya — scorecard + CSV by EOD Tue. Chris — finalized credit schedule & lead times by Tue noon. Matt — add deploy metric + marketplace readiness flag. Ben — co-marketing checklist draft. I'll assemble slide and runbook by Wed morning. :thumbsup:
Matt S: :raised_hands: Thanks!
Anya Gomez: Uploaded template: https://drive.redwood.co/partner-scorecard-template.csv
Ben Liu: I'll start checklist doc. If anyone has examples of previous credit term sheets share here.
Sofia Patel: Perfect — we'll review in the workshop. If anything blocks meeting invite me and I'll reschedule. Thanks all."
